normalized.prelim_summary: This 2015 Mazda MX-5 Miata Grand Touring has just 12,700 miles, a 6-speed manual, and desirable Premium/Suspension packages, backed by strong documentation including Carfax and service records. However, Carfax shows a prior minor front damage incident and there's an existing loan that must be satisfied before title transfer.

critical_evidence.evidence: Carfax documents an antifreeze/coolant flush on 09/17/2021 at 8,606 mi (Valvoline), which is 5+ years ago. No receipt or photo shows the expansion tank or radiator condition or replacement, and both are presumably original at 11 years.

Carfax shows a California emissions pass on 07/07/2026 at 12,583 mi, plus 09/2025, 10/2023 and 03/2022. A CA OBD smog check verifies readiness, no MIL and stock software. This is about 3 months old, so a fresh scan at PPI is still advisable.

The listing includes a 'Start-Up / Roof Demo' video, which was not examined here. The PRHT is visible closed in one photo and open in others. No photos of the floor carpet or pad lifted to show dryness, and no drain test.
No underbody or wheel-well photos were examined here. This matters more given the 2018 front damage report.

There is no transmission, differential, or clutch/brake fluid service in Carfax or the listed service summary; that is no reported entry, not proof it was never done. A bidder raised a cold-start 'chatter' noise; the seller says it is gone in a newer video.

documentation.rationale: The identity half is strong: VIN, clean guaranteed title brands, a Carfax with 2 CA owners, consistent mileage, repeated smog passes and a window sticker. The maintenance half is partial: oil changes, one coolant flush (2021), tires (2024) and brakes. There is nothing on the expansion tank or radiator, gearbox or diff fluids, or underbody, and no repair documents for the 2018 front damage.

condition.rationale: Very low mileage, 2024 tires, recent smog passes and clean-looking photos are partial evidence of good condition. Disclosed flaws are chips, a mirror scratch, front wheel curb rash and bolster wear. A cold-start chatter was raised by a bidder, and the 2018 front damage is unexamined. There is no underbody or cooling evidence.

price_value.rationale: The current bid of $13,450 is well under the $17,509-$22,878 fair-value range, but the reserve is unmet. The hammer will likely land near the low-to-mid fair range. The reported accident and unknown 11-year-old cooling plastics and fluids temper value.

mission_fit.rationale: A manual, stock, smog-legal CA roadster with a durable drivetrain, likely to sell inside the ideal budget band and easy to resell in 6-24 months. It is a direct fit for the enthusiast bridge.

logistics.rationale: Laguna Niguel is a drivable distance from Carmel and the car is CA-registered and smog-passing. However, binding bids close 10/19 with no stated PPI arrangement. The lien adds a KeySavvy/bank payoff step before the title transfers.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Several desirable traits: final-year NC3, Grand Touring, PRHT, 6-speed with the Suspension Package, 12.7k miles, unmodified and a two-owner CA car. Liquid Silver over black is a common colour combination.

what_would_change_verdict: Up: a clean PPI before close, plus an invoice showing a proper 2018 front repair with no structural involvement.
Up: photos of a sound expansion tank and radiator, and confirmation that the cold-start noise is benign.
Down: evidence of a poor front repair, frame or core-support damage, or a clutch or flywheel fault behind the chatter.
Down: the hammer runs above the fair-value range, or no PPI is possible before binding bids close.
evidence.mission_note: This is a stock, smog-passing, 6-speed California roadster likely to sell inside the ideal budget band, a direct fit for the enthusiast bridge in accelerated_bridge mode. The binding auction timeline means inspection has to happen before bidding, not after.
evidence.rationale: The Carfax establishes a two-owner, California-only 2015 NC3 Grand Touring with consistent low mileage (12,583 on 07/07/2026), guaranteed clean title brands and repeated emissions passes. The photos show a 6-speed, PRHT, stock car. Observed issues are a Carfax-reported minor front damage event in 02/2018 with no repair documentation, a bidder-raised cold-start chatter that the seller says has resolved, and disclosed cosmetic flaws including front wheel curb rash. The cluster photo shows warning lamps with the engine apparently off, which reads as a key-on bulb check rather than a fault. Documented maintenance covers oil changes, a 2021 coolant flush, 2024 tires and brakes. There is no reported entry for gearbox, differential, clutch or brake fluid. The expansion tank and radiator are presumably original at 11 years. Roof function, floor dryness and the underbody were not examined here. The reserve is unmet at $13,450 against a fair-value estimate of $17,509-$22,878, and the auction closes 10/19 at 12:36 PDT.
